hints: Differentiate $V = 243 - \frac{1}{3}(9 - x)^3$ with respect to $x$ using the chain rule: $\frac{dV}{dx} = (9 - x)^2$.
Apply the chain rule $\frac{dx}{dt} = \frac{dV/dt}{dV/dx}$ with $\frac{dV}{dt} = 3.6\text{ m}^3/\text{h}$.
Convert the rate from $\text{m/h}$ to $\text{cm/min}$ by multiplying by $\frac{100}{60}$.
walkthrough:
Differentiate the volume expression $V = 243 - \frac{1}{3}(9 - x)^3$ with respect to $x$:
$$\frac{dV}{dx} = -\frac{1}{3} \times 3(9 - x)^2 \times (-1) = (9 - x)^2$$

Evaluate $\frac{dV}{dx}$ when the water depth is $x = 4\text{ m}$:
$$\left.\frac{dV}{dx}\right|_{x=4} = (9 - 4)^2 = 5^2 = 25\text{ m}^2$$

Use the connected rates of change relationship to find $\frac{dx}{dt}$ in $\text{m/h}$:
$$\frac{dx}{dt} = \frac{\frac{dV}{dt}}{\frac{dV}{dx}} = \frac{3.6}{25} = 0.144\text{ m per hour}$$

Convert the rate of change from metres per hour to centimetres per minute:
$$\frac{dx}{dt} = 0.144 \times \frac{100\text{ cm}}{60\text{ min}} = 0.144 \times \frac{5}{3} = 0.24\text{ cm per minute}$$

ai_rubric.Rates of Change: Differentiates to $\frac{dV}{dx} = (9 - x)^2$ (B1). Evaluates derivative at $x=4$ to get $25$ (M1). Applies chain rule $\frac{dx}{dt} = \frac{3.6}{25}$ (M1). Converts units with $\times \frac{100}{60}$ (DM1) to obtain $0.24\text{ cm/min}$ (A1).
